author: poojaranjan
content:
In today’s ACD call, I shared a [list of Glamsterdam and Hegotá PRs](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2197#issuecomment-5440015938) that need attention from authors and other participants.

ACD drives upgrade decisions, while the EIP process documents and carries them forward. For this to work well, the Meta EIP needs to remain the canonical, up-to-date source of upgrade information.

I’d therefore propose adding EIP status updates as a small but regular part of the ACD agenda (just 2–5 minutes) when needed to flag blockers and get the right people’s attention.

I’d especially like to hear from those who disagree or see challenges with this approach. Understanding those concerns can help us find a process that works better for everyone.
